text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand got injured during training, 
so I rushed her straight to the 
infirmary...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I am sorry for causing you 
trouble...
choice_data_list: You have nothing to apologize for!
You have nothing to apologize for!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still... even though you went to the 
trouble of putting together a training 
routine for me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Um... as I thought, could you please 
let me keep practicing within whatever 
limits I can...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even while I'm just sitting here... Big 
sister, Vivlos, and everyone else are 
moving further and further ahead...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand had gotten injured, but her 
motivation for training didn't seem to 
have diminished in the slightest—
choice_data_list:
I understand how you feel, but you really 
have to rest.
...Understood. Let's do the best we can.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Ugh. Rest when you're injured. I 
know that, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even if my body rests, my mind can't find 
peace...!
choice_data_list: Don't worry, you'll definitely catch up!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I-Is that really true?
choice_data_list:
For that to happen, you need to make a 
full recovery first.

For that to happen, you need to make a 
full recovery first.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I'm sorry for throwing a 
tantrum.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Even days when you catch nothing are 
part of fishing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I continued to give Cheval Grand my full 
support afterward so that she could resume 
training as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! I can't afford to rest over 
something like this...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I kept a close eye on Cheval 
Grand as she returned to the training 
grounds, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Running slower than usual... Like this, I 
can...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(—It's no good. Just putting a little 
strength into it makes it throb with 
pain!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I hurried to have Cheval Grand 
rest, her injury was slow to heal, and it 
seemed it would take time before she could 
return.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much! ...I really 
wanted to keep training somehow!
choice_data_list: Alright, off to the library we go!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Image 'training' based on past race 
materials... I see...
choice_data_list:
Let's turn this into a good opportunity 
for some classroom learning!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If I cannot move my body 
outside... I can do so in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... After this, could we also have a 
strategy meeting for the next race...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Cheval Grand took proper care 
of her body and made a smooth, successful 
comeback!
